subject.title: feat(feishu): pass through form_value, input_value, option(s) from card actions

question: What Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw expose when callbacks include both existing `action.value` command/text data and form/input/select fields?
rationale: The code change is owner-local, but the JSON-versus-command behavior becomes agent-visible channel behavior and can affect existing Feishu card workflows.

options.title: Preserve command dispatch while passing fields
options.body: Refresh the PR so `value.command`/`value.text` and current structured envelopes still dispatch normally, while form/input/select fields are attached through a documented parser/decoder path.

options.title: Adopt JSON payloads for rich callbacks
options.body: Accept that form/select callbacks become JSON text, but require explicit maintainer approval, docs or PR-body release context, and upgrade proof for command-style cards.

options.title: Pause for a replacement design
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and replace this branch if maintainers want a broader Feishu interactive-card payload contract before landing code.

recommendation.title: Preserve command dispatch while passing fields
recommendation.body: Refresh the PR so `value.command`/`value.text` and current structured envelopes still dispatch normally, while form/input/select fields are attached through a documented parser/decoder path.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark channel plugin contact, and the unresolved choice is the channel payload contract.
